write.archived: This project is archived (read only). To change it, restore it from the archive in the project list
write.branches.nameMain: A branch cannot be named "main" (main is where branches come from)
write.branches.nameNewline: The {what} cannot contain a line break
write.branches.nameReserved: A branch name cannot be a name wrapped in underscores ({name}); the app uses those (the Project Board is {board}, the tree read from the working directories is {directory})
write.branches.nameSeparators: The {what} cannot contain "@", ":", "." or "/" (they separate paths)
write.branches.nameTilde: A branch name cannot start with "~" (it marks the branches the app makes)
write.branches.nameTooLong: The {what} can be at most 40 characters
write.bundle.noId: The project to move has no id
write.bundle.noRow: The project to move has no row
write.bundle.noTables: The project to move has no contents
write.bundle.otherForm: The store moved from and the store moved to are of different forms (move it once the app and the agent are of the same build)
write.bundle.slugTaken: The destination has a project ({name}) with the slug "{slug}" (rename one of them, then move it)
write.bundle.thereAlready: Project "{name}" is already at the destination
write.holds.groupUnlock: main cannot be unlocked during a group edit (unlock it after you close or cancel the group edit)
write.holds.line.aiMergeOff: Put AI merges into the locked main back to waiting for approval as an MR
write.holds.line.aiMergeOn: Let AI merges into main go in without approval, even while it is locked
write.holds.line.leftGroup: Put the group edit changes into branch {name} (they could not be merged into main)
write.holds.refusalApp: An app batch is in progress ({name}, since {since}). A group edit is in progress in the window, so it cannot be written until it ends
write.holds.refusalAppOn: An app batch is in progress ({name}, since {since}). A group edit is in progress in the window on {client}, so it cannot be written until it ends
write.holds.refusalMcp: An MCP batch is in progress ({name}, since {since}). It cannot be edited until it ends. Cancel the batch with "Cancel" on the window's banner to edit it
write.lockedMain: main is locked (only a merge can change it). Fix it on a branch and merge (MCP writes on the branch named by the branch argument and brings it into main with branch_merge. Into a locked main that becomes an MR, which a person approves)
write.merge.boardNotMerged: The Project Board is not merged (it is a tree outside main and the branches)
write.merge.conflicts: Not merging because there are {count} conflicts. Choose which side to take, then merge: {units}
write.merge.line.intoMain: Merged into main (now the same as main)
write.merge.notWritten: Not merging because {path} could not be written: another one already has its name in the same place. Nothing was written. Rename or delete one of them, then merge
write.merge.overlaps: Not merging because the same path holds different things: {paths}. Rename or delete one of them, then merge
write.merge.placesFromMain: places (taking along the positions moved on the branch) is only for merging a branch (when merging main in, the branch keeps its positions)
write.merge.sameTree: The merge source and the merge target are the same
write.nameTaken: Not written: another card or section already has that name in the same place. Rename or delete one of them, then write it again
write.names.control: The {what} cannot contain a line break, a tab or another control character
write.names.tooLong: The {what} can be at most {max} characters
write.projectFile.cardsMismatch:
Cards in the file do not fit their kind definitions:
{problems}
write.projectFile.newerApp: The file was written by a newer version of the app. Update the app, then read it in
write.projectFile.noName: The project in the file has no name
write.projectFile.notJson: Cannot read it as a project file (it is not JSON)
write.projectFile.notProjectFile: It is not a project file (format is not {format})
write.projectFile.oldVersion: A file of version {version} cannot be read (versions from 11 on can be read; files written under the previous name or by the Swift version are not read)
